title: Aircraft Loan Falcon 900
h1: Aircraft Loan Falcon 900 (search-result title only; actual H1 not revealed)
summary: Case study of a private jet loan arranged by Silver Oak Capital. Borrower: a Dubai-based client introduced by a Swiss family office, buying a used Falcon-class private jet for personal use with a budget capped at about USD 25m; the client wanted a mid-range jet, ideally registered in Dubai, for flights between European and Middle Eastern cities. Challenge: finding the aircraft was harder than arranging the loan because used-aircraft prices had risen and stock at aviation brokers was very thin; Silver Oak says it sourced the aircraft through its own contacts. Lender: a private bank in the Middle East. Structure: 70% loan-to-value, 4.45% fixed rate, 72-month term, quarterly repayments, 1% arrangement fee, 25% balloon. Not revealed by the search results: the absolute loan amount or purchase price, the exact aircraft (beyond 'Falcon 900' in the URL/title and 'Falcon-class' in the snippet), the registration outcome, completion timing or date, the lender's name, and the page's calls to action.
